cause_rules.unavoidable: opslens/floor.py: no legal policy could finish it in time (same roster as the run)
cause_rules.transfer: routed to the wrong team at least once (4-min discovery, back in the queue)
cause_rules.reopen: came back after a first resolution (not already in the unavoidable floor)
cause_rules.cross_skill_too_slow: served cross-skill; the same start at trained speed would have made it
cause_rules.passed_over_*: while it was still savable (expected slack >= 0, before its last trained start), a free trained agent who speaks its language took another ticket with more slack, or a ticket with P(miss even if served now) >= 0.95; the label is the worst such pick: lost ticket > cross-skill job > lower priority > same/higher priority
cause_rules.skill_gap: no trained agent in its language on shift between arrival and its last start
cause_rules.busy_when_it_landed: trained agents in its language were on shift but none started any work between its arrival and its last start (all busy)
cause_rules.congestion_more_urgent_work: trained agents started work in its window, but only on tickets with less slack than it had

staffing_targets.rule_now: Erlang C mean wait <= 15 min, occupancy <= 0.85
staffing_targets.rule_proposed: Erlang C P(wait > tightest promise (10th pct) - AHT) <= 20%, occupancy <= 0.85

note: validation days 36-42 only (warm-up day 35); diagnosis, not an adoption test
